title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.2
subtitle: Create directional Sewing paths directly in the viewport.

highlights.title: Endpoint-based Sewing
highlights.description: Pick two endpoints on each side and Cloth NeXt follows a deterministic, boundary-aware shortest path between them.

highlights.title: Directional path mapping
highlights.description: Preview correspondence lines and flip their direction before committing the seam.

highlights.title: Intra- and cross-object seams
highlights.description: Persist, validate, display, and bake seams within one Cloth object or between two Cloth objects.
